Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                          ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1 Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all of RS 3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-H in the area bounded by:

        The public alley next north of and parallel to West Superior Street; a line
        102.75 feet west of and parallel to North Paulina Street; West Superior
        Street; and a line 127.75 feet west of and parallel to North Paulina Street.

to those of a RT 4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
